sections.text:
**Evaluating current recommendations**

I need to find the latest recommendations regarding SEO and AI in search. This field changes rapidly, so it seems crucial to explore what's currently relevant. I should check recent sources to understand how SEO strategies might be adapting or changing due to AI advancements. It’s essential to ensure I’m providing up-to-date information for the user, so searching for the latest updates is my next step!

AI SEO — often called **GEO** / **AEO** / **LLM optimization** — is basically making your site easy for Google AI Overviews, Bing Copilot, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, and other answer engines to **crawl, understand, trust, summarize, and cite**. Here’s a practical plan. ## 1. Start with normal SEO fundamentals AI search still depends heavily on conventional search infrastructure: crawlability, indexability, authority, relevance, and structured content. Google says its AI search systems rely on the same basic ways Google Search finds and processes pages, so foundational SEO still matters. ([developers.google.cn](https://developers.google.cn/search/docs/fundamentals/ai-optimization-guide?hl=en&utm_source=openai)) Do this first: - Make sure important pages are **indexable**. - Submit XML sitemaps. - Fix broken pages, redirect chains, duplicate canonicals, and thin pages. - Use fast, mobile-friendly pages. - Write clear title tags and meta descriptions. - Build topical internal links. - Earn authoritative backlinks and mentions. - Use HTTPS. - Make sure your content is actually visible in HTML, not hidden behind scripts. ## 2. Create pages that answer specific questions clearly AI search systems often surface concise answers from pages that are easy to parse. Instead of only writing broad blog posts, create pages that answer concrete user intents. Good formats: - “What is X?” - “How to do X” - “X vs Y” - “Best X for Y” - “Cost of X” - “X checklist” - “X requirements” - “X troubleshooting” - “Step-by-step guide to X” Example structure: ```text H1: How to Choose the Right CRM for a Small Law Firm Short answer: The best CRM for a small law firm should include contact management, matter tracking, document storage, intake automation, conflict checking, and secure client communications. Then sections: - What features matter most? - CRM comparison table - Cost ranges - Implementation checklist - Common mistakes - FAQ ``` The key is to make each page **answer-shaped**. ## 3. Add “direct answer” blocks near the top AI systems love clean, self-contained explanations. Add a short answer under important headings: ```text What is technical SEO? Technical SEO is the process of improving a website’s crawlability, indexability, speed, structure, and metadata so search engines can understand and rank its pages more effectively. ``` Then go deeper below. This helps with: - Featured snippets - AI Overviews - ChatGPT Search citations - Bing Copilot answers - Voice/search assistants ## 4. Use structured data/schema Schema helps search engines understand your page entities, products, reviews, FAQs, authors, organizations, breadcrumbs, and articles. Google recommends following its structured data guidelines, including making sure marked-up content is visible on the page and validating the markup. ([developers.google.com](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data/sd-policies?utm_source=openai)) Use relevant schema types such as: - `Organization` - `LocalBusiness` - `Product` - `Service` - `Article` - `BlogPosting` - `FAQPage` - `HowTo` - `BreadcrumbList` - `Person` - `Review` - `AggregateRating` - `VideoObject` - `SoftwareApplication` - `Event` Example FAQ schema: ```json { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "FAQPage", "mainEntity": [ { "@type": "Question", "name": "What is AI SEO?", "acceptedAnswer": { "@type": "Answer", "text": "AI SEO is the process of optimizing website content so AI-powered search engines and answer engines can discover, understand, summarize, and cite it." } } ] } ``` Don’t spam schema. Only mark up content that actually appears on the page. ## 5. Make your content citation-worthy AI tools tend to cite pages that are authoritative, specific, and fact-rich. Include: - Original statistics - Clear definitions - Step-by-step processes - Comparison tables - Pricing ranges - Expert commentary - Case studies - Research summaries - Unique examples - Downloadable templates - Updated dates - Author bios - Sources and references Bad AI SEO content: ```text Marketing is important for every business. In today’s digital world, businesses need marketing strategies to grow... ``` Better AI SEO content: ```text For a B2B SaaS company under $5M ARR, the highest-leverage SEO pages are usually integration pages, comparison pages, use-case pages, pricing-alternative pages, and bottom-funnel “best software for X” pages. ``` Specific beats generic. ## 6. Build topical authority Don’t publish random isolated posts. Build clusters. Example for a cybersecurity company: ```text Main page: - Cybersecurity for Small Businesses Supporting pages: - Small business cybersecurity checklist - Best endpoint protection for small businesses - How much does cybersecurity cost? - SOC 2 vs ISO 27001 - Phishing prevention guide - Ransomware response plan - Cybersecurity insurance requirements - Employee security awareness training ``` Then internally link them together. AI systems need to understand that your site is a reliable source on a topic, not just one article. ## 7. Optimize for entities, not just keywords AI search is entity-driven. Make it very clear who you are, what you offer, where you operate, and what topics you’re authoritative in. Create or improve these pages: - About page - Contact page - Author bio pages - Service pages - Product pages - Location pages - Case studies - Press/media page - Customer reviews/testimonials - FAQ page Mention important entities naturally: - Brand name - Founder names - Product names - Service categories - Locations served - Industry - Certifications - Partners - Integrations - Awards - Publications ## 8. Don’t block AI search crawlers accidentally Check your `robots.txt`. For ChatGPT Search visibility, OpenAI says your content needs to be accessible to **OAI-SearchBot**; if you block it, your content may not be included in ChatGPT summaries/snippets. ([help.openai.com](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/12627856-publishers-and-developers-faq%23%3A~%3Atext%3DChatGPT%20automatically%20includes%20the%20UTM%20parameter%20utm_source%3Dchatgpt.com%20in%20referral%20URLs%2C%20enabling%20clear%20tracking%20and%20analysis%20of%20inbound%20traffic%20from%20ChatGPT%20search%20results?utm_source=openai)) Example permissive rule: ```txt User-agent: OAI-SearchBot Allow: / ``` Also make sure you’re not accidentally blocking: ```txt User-agent: Bingbot User-agent: Googlebot User-agent: PerplexityBot User-agent: ClaudeBot User-agent: GPTBot ``` Important distinction: **OAI-SearchBot** is for ChatGPT Search discovery/citation; **GPTBot** is associated with model training. You may choose different rules depending on your policy. ## 9. Use Bing Webmaster Tools Bing is especially important because Bing data can influence Copilot and other Microsoft AI search experiences. Bing’s webmaster guidance explicitly says SEO best practices that support discovery, indexing accuracy, and content clarity also support eligibility for AI-generated experiences, grounding results, and citations. ([bing.com](https://www.bing.com/webmasters/help/webmaster-guidelines-30fba23a?success=true&utm_source=openai)) Set up: - Bing Webmaster Tools - Google Search Console - XML sitemap submission - IndexNow, if relevant - Crawl error monitoring - Structured data validation Bing has also introduced AI Performance reporting in Webmaster Tools to help site owners understand visibility in AI-powered search surfaces. ([blogs.bing.com](https://blogs.bing.com/webmaster/February-2026/Introducing-AI-Performance-in-Bing-Webmaster-Tools-Public-Preview?utm_source=openai)) ## 10. Format content for extraction Use clean, semantic HTML. Good: ```html

Best Payroll Software for Restaurants

Quick Recommendation

The best payroll software for restaurants should include tip reporting, shift scheduling integrations, multi-state tax support, and time-clock syncing.

Comparison Table

Software Best For Starting Price
``` Avoid: - Huge walls of text - Vague headings like “Overview” - Important text embedded only in images - Content hidden in accordions that search engines may not easily parse - Overly clever marketing language - Pages with no clear answer ## 11. Add FAQ sections FAQs are excellent for AI SEO because they map directly to user prompts. Add 5–10 real questions per important page. Example: ```text FAQ How much does managed IT support cost? What is included in managed IT services? Is managed IT better than hiring an internal IT person? How long does onboarding take? Do managed IT providers handle cybersecurity? ``` Each answer should be short first, then detailed if needed. ## 12. Keep content fresh AI search favors current, reliable answers for many topics. For important pages: - Add “Last updated” dates. - Update stats and pricing. - Remove outdated tools or advice. - Refresh screenshots. - Re-test recommendations. - Update comparisons quarterly or semiannually. This is especially important for software, finance, health, law, marketing, travel, and technology topics. ## 13. Build brand mentions outside your website AI systems
